text:
The search points primarily to one new paper and pages discussing it:

1. **EAU: Environment-Agent-User Co-evolution for Training User-Centric Agents** — Primary arXiv paper, submitted October 12, 2026. It proposes a meta-agent that jointly adapts the training environment, user simulator, rewards, and agent configuration.  
   **People:** Min Cai — University of Alberta; Dan Zhang — National University of Singapore; Gao Xing and Libin Ma — Kuaishou Technology; Zhaohui Xu — independent researcher; Xi Ye — University of Alberta and Alberta Machine Intelligence Institute (Amii).  
   **URL:** [arxiv.org/abs/2610.16523](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.16523)

2. **EAU project page** — Companion site linked from the paper; intended to provide project materials and presentation of the method.  
   **People/affiliations:** Same research team and affiliations listed above.  
   **URL:** [eau-meta-agent.github.io](https://eau-meta-agent.github.io/)

3. **Pith review of EAU** — An AI-generated critical review. It highlights the reported performance gains but questions unmatched compute budgets and dependence on proprietary meta-agents.  
   **People:** The same six paper authors; review produced through Pith using a DeepSeek model. Author affiliations are those listed above.  
   **URL:** [pith.science/paper/2610.16523](https://pith.science/paper/2610.16523)

4. **Min Cai’s research page** — Lead author’s page announcing EAU and describing it as a framework for co-evolving agents with their learning environments.  
   **People:** Min Cai — PhD student at the University of Alberta, supervised by Xi Ye; the page also notes prior research roles at Baidu and Z.ai.  
   **URL:** [henrycai11.github.io](https://henrycai11.github.io/)

1. **arXiv paper — “EAU: Environment-Agent-User Co-evolution for Training User-Centric Agents.”**  
   Min Cai — University of Alberta; Dan Zhang — National University of Singapore; Gao Xing and Libin Ma — Kuaishou Technology; Zhaohui Xu — independent researcher; Xi Ye — University of Alberta and Alberta Machine Intelligence Institute (Amii).  
   https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.16523

2. **Official EAU project page.**  
   Same six-person research team and affiliations listed above; linked directly from the paper.  
   https://eau-meta-agent.github.io/

3. **Pith paper review and technical breakdown.**  
   Covers the work by Cai, Zhang, Xing, Ma, Xu, and Ye, with the affiliations above. Pith highlights the framework’s reported gains but questions the lack of compute-matched comparisons; its displayed review was generated by a DeepSeek-V4-Flash AI referee.  
   https://pith.science/paper/2610.16523

1. **EAU: Environment-Agent-User Co-evolution for Training User-Centric Agents** — The direct match. Introduces a meta-agent that jointly adapts the user simulator, environment, rewards, and RL configuration.  
   **People:** Min Cai — University of Alberta; Dan Zhang — National University of Singapore; Gao Xing and Libin Ma — Kuaishou Technology; Zhaohui Xu — independent researcher; Xi Ye — University of Alberta and Alberta Machine Intelligence Institute (Amii).  
   **URL:** [arXiv paper](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.16523) · [Project site](https://eau-meta-agent.github.io/)

2. **EAU paper review and technical breakdown — Pith** — Independent AI-generated assessment of the EAU paper, highlighting its reported gains while questioning whether baseline compute budgets were matched.  
   **People:** Same six paper authors and affiliations listed above; review generated by a DeepSeek model rather than a named human reviewer.  
   **URL:** [Pith review](https://pith.science/paper/2610.16523)

3. **The Next Paradigm Is User-Centric Agent, Not Platform-Centric Service** — Closely related position paper proposing user-controlled, privacy-oriented agents operating through a device–cloud architecture. It is about the broader user-centric-agent paradigm, not the EAU meta-agent itself.  
   **People:** Luankang Zhang, Hang Lv, Qiushi Pan, Kefen Wang, Yonghao Huang, Xinrui Miao, Yin Xu, Hao Wang, and Enhong Chen — University of Science and Technology of China and the State Key Laboratory of Cognitive Intelligence; Wei Guo and Yong Liu — Huawei Technologies.  
   **URL:** [arXiv paper](https://arxiv.org/abs/2602.15682)
